### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

➡️ [Discord][discord] | [Installation Guide][toc-install] | [Usage Guide][usage-guide] ⬅️ **Fast, smart, effective.** The Modern Port Scanner. **Find ports quickly (3 seconds at its fastest)**. Run scripts through our scripting engine (Python, Lua, Shell supported). You can install RustScan's binary from our [releases page](https://github.com/RustScan/RustScan/releases). We would prefer you to install with a package manager so it is tested and works for your system. RustScan is in many repositories already.
